in_marathi.name: Dhruvasha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of the Dynasty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvasha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit 'dhruva' meaning 'fixed' and 'asha' meaning 'hope'. Represents a stable and reliable person who brings hope to their family.
